definitions.explanation: Concentrated, rigorous training beyond the usual level. Often implies extra practice sessions or boot-camp-style preparation for a competition, exam, or performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特訓|とっくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I underwent special training during summer break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{特訓|とっくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I am receiving intensive training from my coach before the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧{特訓|とっくん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm bad at presentations, I asked a senior colleague to put me through intensive practice.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb. Implies training that is more intensive, focused, or demanding than regular practice. Common in sports, academics, and skill-building contexts. Often has an enthusiastic or determined tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特訓|とっくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to undergo special training
- {特訓|とっくん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do intensive training
- {猛|もう}{特訓|とっくん}: fierce/grueling special training
- {特訓|とっくん}⟦{合宿|がっしゅく}→合宿：11901_gasshuku⟧: intensive training camp
